notes.title: 2.0 version update - Blood Moon Descend
notes.content:
2.0 version update -Blood Moon Descent


1. Added level 6 advanced elements with attributes of Wind, Thunder, Water, and Fire: Death of Daedalus, Leize, Hell Creator, and Guardians of Siva

2. Add 81-100 waves of monsters: God's Will, God's Messenger

3. Add advanced elements: Ice Prison and Cloud Zeus

4. Added a new hidden element: the evil god Avata

5. New scene environment - Blood Moon

6. Modified the calculation method for percentage damage, now the damage value will be affected by the monster level

7. Reset Rank leaderboard

8. Other optimizations

notes.content:

notes.title: 12.12-Update Arcana System
notes.content:
New External Growth and Development System - Arcana

1. Click the "Arcana" button in the upper right corner to open the system interface

2. Players can obtain diamonds by defeating level bosses

3. Consuming diamonds can activate permanent talents

4.Currently, only the first page of Arcane is open

notes.title: 12.9 Update
notes.content:
1. Added button effects for store refresh

2. Adjusted some UI displays

3. Added skip option when drawing cards

4. Added attribute preview function when building elements

Update trailer:

The game is about to enter a talent tree system, where players can obtain diamonds by defeating bosses in each game. Consuming diamonds can activate permanent talents!
